svg.title: Canadian home energy upgrade order by typical payback
svg.desc: Air sealing and attic first, then thermostats and habits, then lighting and appliances, then heating equipment, then windows, then solar unless a live rebate or net-metering rule is unusually strong.
svg.text: Upgrade order: cheap leaks before expensive toys
Canadian climate stack. Not a U.S. solar-first brochure. Sketch for 20 Sep 2026.
1. Air seal + attic - highest leak, lowest regret
2. Thermostat + habits - existing plant, better hours
3. LEDs + thirsty appliances - quick wins, small bills
4. Heat plant - repair, furnace, or heat pump
5. Windows - film / inserts before full replacement
6. Solar - last unless the live stack is strong
Gas-heat Ontario vs electric-heat Quebec change the heating fork, not the leak-first rule. Education only.
